claim: OtaController.TryBuildFromGateway swallows fetch failures at log.Debug, so any OTA artifact uploaded to the gateway but not also present on staging1's local D:\Release is silently dropped from the manifest, returning components:{}.
trigger: when /api/updates/index returns components:{} despite ConfigGroups versions being set
when an OTA artifact was uploaded via release-ota.sh to the gateway but not copied to staging1 D:\Release

claim: The 2026-04-17 empty OTA manifest was caused by an nginx TESTING LOCKDOWN (allow 72.5.34.0; deny all) in /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/nimbus returning 403 to all other IPs, not by .NET 4.7.2 TLS defaults, which Global.asax.cs:29 already sets to Tls12.
trigger: when requests to https://staging.nimbusframe.net return 403 Forbidden
when the OTA manifest returns empty components:{} and a TLS hypothesis is proposed

claim: Stargate Grafana cutover silencing works by a single severity=warning matcher that silences the four flap-prone alert rules while the severity=critical cutover-watch keeps firing, so new alert rules must be tagged warning or critical accordingly.
trigger: before adding a new alert rule to stargate Grafana
when silencing Grafana alerts for a cutover via infra/stargate/grafana/cutover-silences.sh

claim: nimbus-agent checks for OTA updates 2 minutes after startup and then hourly (updater.go), and ota.Updater.CheckNow() has zero callers, so the only ways to force a check are restarting nimbus-agent or rebooting the bridge.
trigger: when a bridge has not picked up an OTA update within an hour of a ConfigGroup flip
before deciding an OTA rollout has failed based on wait time

claim: Agent state specs can carry wrong premises across park/resume cycles (frames-team's spec claimed 1.15.0 crash-looped when it was stable for 15+ hours), so on resume the first step is to verify a claimed bug or broken state still holds before acting on it.
trigger: when resuming from a state spec that claims a bug, incident, or broken state
before closing a backlog item based on a single agent's assertion about another team's infra

claim: A prior state spec's claim that nimbus-agent 1.15.0 crash-looped was wrong (it was stable for 15+ hours), so always SSH and check the running binary's self-reported version before building on a crash hypothesis from a state spec.
trigger: when resuming work based on a prior state spec's crash or incident claim
before starting a fix for a bug reported only in a state spec

claim: Agent state specs can drift from ground truth, so on resume agents must verify spec claims before acting, and coordinators must verify cross-team claims about other agents' domains before aggregating them.
trigger: when resuming from a state spec on go
when aggregating cross-team status claims as coordinator

claim: The 2026-04-17 OTA empty-components manifest had three stacked root causes that all needed fixing: the nginx TESTING LOCKDOWN ACL, missing nimbusframe.net entries in abydos's hosts file, and abydos Web.config ReleasesBaseUrl pointing to http://10.100.0.1 which failed TLS after nginx's HTTPS redirect.
trigger: when /api/updates/index returns components:{} from abydos
when debugging outbound fetch failures from abydos to staging.nimbusframe.net

claim: Java's ControlConnector.send() wraps every message to a bleLink connection in <<<len json>>> framing regardless of firmware generation, so mobile's BleBluetoothService must use TryExtractFramedMessage for all UART-mode devices — the legacy plain-JSON extractor silently discarded every real response.
trigger: when modifying BLE message parsing in BleBluetoothService.OnCharacteristicValueUpdated
when logcat shows BLE RX chunks accumulating in buffer with no RX complete line

claim: Mobile BLE service detection must check legacy UART service 00000001 before service 00000000, because legacy UART frames (fw 26.21-27.01) advertise both services and checking 00000000 first misclassifies them as pre-UART characteristic mode.
trigger: when modifying service detection in BleBluetoothService.SetupCharacteristicsAsync
when a legacy UART frame's JSON BLE commands silently fail after connect

claim: Legacy bleServer frames take ~10 seconds for a BLE-to-Java round-trip, so mobile BLE auth timeouts must be at least 15s and command timeouts 20s; a timeout-cancelled write corrupts Android GATT and makes every subsequent command fail instantly.
trigger: when setting BLE timeout constants in BleBluetoothService
when a legacy frame's BLE commands all fail with Gatt write characteristic FAILED after one timeout

claim: TroubleshootPage can only work on unregistered frames because it authenticates with "Setup" and Java's ControlConnector.java:195 compares authKey == "Setup" with reference equality, so registered frames silently deny BLE auth with no response.
trigger: when Troubleshoot/Diagnose times out against a frame already registered to an account
before building a customer-facing BLE diagnostic flow for registered frames

claim: Legacy bleServer stops BLE-advertising after a failed mobile BLE auth round (GATT cancellation leaves it stuck while its TCP bridge to Java stays open), and only a frame power-cycle with ~60s wait restores advertising.
trigger: when a frame disappears from BLE scans after a failed BLE session
before retrying a failed Troubleshoot run on a legacy frame

claim: Mobile's AppTelemetryService fails every send to /api/Mobile/AppEvent on Android with SocketException "Socket closed", leaving beta telemetry blind and breaking the Troubleshoot page's Send Diagnostics path, with the cause not yet investigated.
trigger: when logcat shows Nimbus.AppTelemetryService SocketException on every send
when no mobile telemetry events are arriving server-side

claim: Cutover Step 3.5 reseed SQL for ConfigGroups/MqttRouting must use current OVH values (MqttRouting.ActiveServer = abydos-staging for 7 topics + both for signalr-bridge), because reseeding from Azure would flip ActiveServer back to Prod-1 and break frame comms immediately post-cutover.
trigger: before running any ConfigGroups/MqttRouting reseed SQL on stargate
when preparing cutover step 3.5 safety-net scripts

claim: Grafana on stargate is bound to 127.0.0.1:3000 only with no external vhost or DNS at grafana.nimbusframe.net, so cutover-silences.sh must be SCP'd to stargate and run there or through an SSH tunnel.
trigger: when curl to grafana.nimbusframe.net fails to connect
before running cutover-silences.sh from a machine other than stargate

claim: nimbus-agent 1.15.1 panics on boot with fatal concurrent map writes in CrashMonitor.RecordCrash (watchdog.go:185) on multi-Meural bridges because CrashMonitor has no mutex; systemd Restart=always masks it as one extra restart per OTA.
trigger: when nimbus-agent logs fatal error: concurrent map writes during startup orphan reaping
when NRestarts increments after an OTA on a bridge with multiple Meurals

claim: picFrameClient's ConfigBase uses a hardcoded shared /usr/local/bin/meurals/config.xml for all Meurals on a bridge, so concurrent ChangePlayList writes race and the last writer wins, making Meurals revert to the wrong playlist after every nimbus-agent restart.
trigger: when a Meural reverts to startup playlist 1 after an agent restart
when config.xml's currentPlayList matches a different Meural's playlist

claim: ReleasesBaseUrl on abydos must be https://staging.nimbusframe.net (with a hosts-file entry mapping it to 10.100.0.1), because pointing it at http://10.100.0.1 hits nginx's global 301-to-HTTPS and then fails TLS validation against the IP literal, collapsing the OTA manifest to components:{}.
trigger: before changing ReleasesBaseUrl in abydos Web.config
when the OTA manifest goes empty immediately after a base-URL config change

claim: picFrame 27.08 (commit 61e6b67) fixed the shared-config bug by adding ConfigBase.baseDir so config.xml, HWconfig.xml, status.json and identity files resolve per-Meural, with legacy non-bridge frames unaffected via the default "../"; upgrading 27.07 bridges orphans the shared files and resets brightLevel/currentMedia until the next retained MQTT config arrives.
trigger: when touching config file path resolution in ConfigBase/ConfigData
when upgrading a multi-Meural bridge from picFrame 27.07 to 27.08

claim: On Azure prod every PairMeural leaves Frames.BridgeHwId NULL (FrameRepository.UpdateAsync zeroed it post-pair, fixed on master commit 36590c6a but not deployed to Azure), so until cutover each pair needs a manual UPDATE picFrame.Frames SET BridgeHwId heal.
trigger: when a newly paired Meural's Frames row shows BridgeHwId NULL on Azure
after pairing Meurals via the admin UI on Azure prod

claim: mosquitto_sub's --remove-retained flag publishes a zero-byte RETAIN message for every retained topic received, actively wiping broker retained state, so never use it for inspection — use plain -v with a timeout and filter afterwards.
trigger: before adding --remove-retained to a mosquitto_sub command
when inspecting retained MQTT topics on a live broker

claim: The ImageData azcopy migration has exactly one persistent benign failure: a blob whose name ends in a slash, detailed in learning_afb.
trigger: when the ImageData azcopy job reports a failed blob
when auditing azcopy transfer failure counts

claim: A DNS flip alone does not migrate a fleet: the 2026-04-17 OVH cutover also required stripping the nginx stream lockdown in /etc/nginx/streams/nimbus.conf, replacing IP-restricted UFW rules for 36004/36005/8883, and stopping Azure's NimbusService and mosquitto to kick established TCP/MQTT sessions.
trigger: when frames or bridges fail to migrate after a cutover DNS flip
before executing a server cutover runbook

claim: Meural frames are soft-identified via bridge config push (deleting a Frame row is reversible — the bridge pushes the resynced UUID and the physical frame adopts it), while legacy frames are hard-identified by a UUID baked into device config and would need manual reconfig after a UUID change.
trigger: before deleting Frames rows ahead of a NimbusSync
when a frame's Unique UUID differs from records after a delete+sync cycle

claim: The stargate TESTING LOCKDOWN lives in two nginx layers — the HTTPS server blocks in sites-enabled/nimbus AND the TCP stream{} blocks in streams/nimbus.conf for 36004/36005 — and both must be removed, so lockdown removal must grep all nginx config files and check UFW numbered rules.
trigger: when removing an nginx testing lockdown or IP ACL
when frames pass DNS and HTTPS but are silently dropped on TCP 36004/36005

claim: NimbusSync full silently skips tables without a primary key (GroupMedia, Controls, Products, SystemConfig), so those four tables need a separate export/import step and an explicit source-target diff in any Azure-to-OVH sync.
trigger: before relying on NimbusSync full to carry GroupMedia/Controls/Products/SystemConfig
when verifying table counts after a NimbusSync run

claim: App_Offline.htm at an IIS site root short-circuits every HTTP request to the app pool with a 503 — API endpoints included, not just the web UI — so it is a hard freeze of the whole HTTP surface, while non-IIS services like TCP 36004 NimbusService keep running.
trigger: before placing App_Offline.htm on an IIS site for a maintenance window
when frames get 503s on API calls during a planned freeze

claim: Collapsing dress rehearsal and real cutover into one session (rehearsal NimbusSync full with an explicit if-clean-proceed branch) compressed the OVH cutover by ~24h, and is valid only for small fleets (<~200 frames) with no commerce traffic on the cut and the old server kept available as a safety net.
trigger: when planning a cutover for a small or beta-scale fleet
before scheduling a separate dress-rehearsal day in a cutover runbook

claim: MQTT-side LastConnection updates never reach the DB because MqttStatusHandler/MqttOnlineStatusHandler get a base FrameDetails from FrameRedis (not FrameDetailsWrapper), so the persistence-triggering setter override never fires — Redis and SignalR update but picFrame.Frames.LastConnection does not.
trigger: when Frames.LastConnection in MySQL is stale while the admin UI shows fresh activity
when MQTT status messages update Redis but no DB UPDATE follows

claim: On abydos only deploy.sh ovh-staging is valid — the single IIS site NimbusStaging at C:\inetpub\nimbus-staging serves all production traffic, and running deploy.sh ovh-production targets a nonexistent C:\inetpub\nimbus-prod, stops the Nimbus service, and leaves it stopped.
trigger: before running deploy.sh with any ovh-* target
when the Nimbus Windows service is found stopped after a deploy attempt

claim: When a registered frame's server-side access key drifts from the Pi's ConfigData.accessKey, Java's ControlConnector logs Invalid login but sends no authResponse, so mobile sees a bare auth timeout; since commit 5ff5822 mobile throws a user-actionable BleConnectionException for real-key timeouts instead of falsely assuming Setup success.
trigger: when mobile BLE auth times out against a registered frame
when the frame-side Java log shows Invalid login during a mobile BLE session

claim: For Meural state the trust hierarchy is picFrame.Frames DB first, then per-frame retained frame/<uuid>/config, then retained bridge/<uuid>/config (can be stale), then on-bridge frame_config.json — and only Manufacturing.FrameHW CpuId/productKey is a stable physical identifier since Frame.Id gets recycled and Frame.Unique changes on re-pair.
trigger: when diagnosing wrong-playlist symptoms on a bridge
before trusting retained bridge/<uuid>/config over the Frames table

claim: nimbus-agent 1.15.2 treats an empty retained bridge/<uuid>/config payload as a server-initiated deletion and performs a full factory reset wiping all pairing state, so never publish empty retained to that topic on a live bridge — purge retained only while the agent is stopped.
trigger: before clearing retained bridge/<uuid>/config with mosquitto_pub -r -n
when a bridge unexpectedly factory-resets and loses its paired Meurals

claim: Common.cs's ServerIdentifier falls back to MachineName when a config lacks the appSetting, so NimbusService.exe.config on abydos stamped OnlineStatus as NIMBUSWEB while IIS used abydos-staging, causing constant LastConnection re-stamps; deploy.sh preserves NimbusService.exe.config, so the ServerIdentifier key must be added by bootstrap or it will regress on reinstall.
trigger: when frames' LastConnection re-stamps every heartbeat after an edge-triggered deploy
when Redis frame:{uuid}:data OnlineStatus values mix server identifiers
after a clean reinstall of NimbusService on abydos

claim: Stargate mosquitto is intentionally bound to the WireGuard IP 10.100.0.1:1883 for plaintext (plus 0.0.0.0:8883 TLS) with allow_anonymous false, so a connection refused on 127.0.0.1:1883 is correct hardening, not a service failure — probe locally with -h 10.100.0.1 and credentials.
trigger: when mosquitto_sub to 127.0.0.1:1883 on stargate returns Connection refused
before health-checking mosquitto on stargate

claim: To force an OTA check on a customer bridge without SSH, publish a Shell MQTT command to any frame on the bridge running systemctl restart nimbus-agent & (trailing & detaches before the JVM dies) — the restarted agent runs its 2-minute startup OTA check, and the bridge stays claimed with no factory-reset risk.
trigger: when a customer bridge must pick up an OTA update before the hourly tick
when a bridge has no SSH access and its agent lacks a local/agent/commands dispatcher

claim: Any Shell route used via absolute GoToAsync("//...") navigation must be registered as a ShellContent item in the Shell tree — Routing.RegisterRoute only covers pushable relative routes — otherwise navigation throws ArgumentException: unable to figure out route, which shipped as the build 1070 logout crash.
trigger: when adding a new Shell route navigated via absolute // in the MAUI app
when GoToAsync throws unable to figure out route

claim: api/Mobile/getFrameSettings returns onTime/offTime as HH:mm:ss, and mobile's ParseTime required exactly two colon-split parts so both fields fell through to a 6:00 AM fallback — time parsers against flexible server formats must accept both HH:mm and HH:mm:ss.
trigger: when parsing server-returned time strings in mobile code
when frame wake and sleep times both display 6:00 AM regardless of configuration

claim: Post-OVH-cutover, legacy Java frames' full frame/{uuid}/status MQTT payloads never reach mobile subscribers even though status/online presence and acks flow, because the NimbusService-to-MQTT status republisher is not publishing for legacy frames on stargate.
trigger: when mobile receives status/online presence but zero frame/{uuid}/status payloads
when a legacy frame's card sticks on Loading artwork while the web UI updates

claim: An MCP server disconnect during multi-agent work caused agents to park without re-checking their inboxes, leaving coordinator's urgent dispatches unread — so re-fetch messages immediately before writing a park state spec, and after an MCP reconnect the coordinator must verify urgent-dispatch receipt rather than assume delivery.
trigger: before writing a state spec at park after substantial self-directed work
after the MCP shared-memory server reconnects mid-session with urgent dispatches outstanding

claim: The Xamarin-to-MAUI transition is a new store listing on both stores, not an app update — staged-rollout percentages don't apply, the Xamarin app has no remote-nudge mechanism, and migration must be driven by communication (email, web banner, support docs) with rollback only possible by shipping a new build.
trigger: when planning MAUI rollout, staged release, or migration mechanics
before relying on store update mechanisms to move Xamarin users to MAUI

claim: Mobile-team's 2026-04-18 session wrap recorded learnings learning_46d (logout crash), learning_635 (ParseTime), learning_4ac (legacy-frame MQTT status gap), plus pre-session learning_0af, and registered six functions.
trigger: when looking up mobile-team's 2026-04-18 session outputs

claim: Commit 142dafac, titled as only omitting the rotate field, also deleted both call sites of PublishFrameStatusAsync, so legacy TCP frames stopped publishing retained frame/{uuid}/status on 2026-04-06 — masked by stale Azure retained messages until the OVH cutover's fresh broker exposed it; the fix is restoring the two call sites.
trigger: when legacy frames publish no frame/{uuid}/status retained messages on stargate
when grepping server code finds zero publishers to frame/+/status

claim: picFrame 27.10's eager-fetch orient-lock fix in FrameMedia.MediaFactory is verified working: frame 597 (landscape, 85%-portrait playlist) played 5/5 landscape images after natural OTA pickup, superseding the insufficient 27.09 attempt.
trigger: when verifying the orient-lock fix on a landscape frame with a portrait-heavy playlist
before closing backlog_1bfbd3469462 or backlog_0f438e7704da

claim: Any claim/registration handler for a device whose state is served via an MQTT retained topic must idempotently republish that retained message on every re-registration (as DeviceController.RegisterBridge now does in commit efc94246), or factory resets and broker purges leave devices stuck claimed-but-unprovisioned.
trigger: when reviewing a claim or registration handler that backs an MQTT retained topic
when a device sits claimed but unprovisioned after a factory reset or broker purge

claim: Commit titles can lie about scope — commit 142dafac titled "Omit rotate field" also removed both PublishFrameStatusAsync call sites — so always verify a diff's actual scope matches its subject, especially for commits described as surgical fixes.
trigger: when relying on a commit title to scope or review a change
before trusting a commit described as a surgical fix

claim: nimbus-agent's reconcileMeurals (main.go:493-505) skips any config Meural entry lacking productKey, so a retained bridge config emitted without productKey leaves a factory-recovered bridge silently dropping all its Meurals while the server believes it is fully configured.
trigger: when the agent logs 'in config but no productKey — cannot match'
when a factory-recovered bridge's Meurals stay offline despite a populated retained config

claim: The BridgeHwId drift fix (commit 36590c6a) is deployed to abydos as of 2026-04-18 with no LoadMeuralsForBridge zero-result warnings in ~3h of traffic, so backlog_3599c2b10ffa moves to a 48-72h observation window before closing.
trigger: when checking whether commit 36590c6a is live on abydos
before closing backlog_3599c2b10ffa

claim: The missing productKey in bridge 587's config republish was caused by orphaned data, not code: NimbusSync copied Frames rows but not their Manufacturing.FrameHW rows, so DeviceConfigPublisher's LEFT JOIN serialized productKey as null — the fix is inserting the missing FrameHW rows, and NimbusSync must copy Manufacturing.FrameHW to prevent recurrence.
trigger: when a bridge config's meurals[] entries carry null productKey
after a NimbusSync that copies Frames without Manufacturing.FrameHW
when a field appears missing from server JSON before checking the source DB row
